Turn on **Limit credits** and choose **Per member** or **Entire group**. **Per member** gives each person a separate spending cap: a 50,000-credit limit means each member can use up to 50,000 credits during the selected reset period. **Entire group** gives everyone one shared cap: a 50,000-credit limit means all members together can use up to 50,000 credits during that period.\n\n4. Set the amount and **Reset frequency**: **Daily**, **Weekly**, or **Monthly**. For Monthly, also set the **Limit reset date**.\n\n5. Add model restrictions if needed, then click **Create group.**\n\n## Block models or resolutions\n\n- Choose **Restrict models → Add**, then select a model. Selected models are blocked for the group.\n\n- Use **Res.** beside a model to block a specific resolution.\n\n- Use **LLM**, where available, to restrict language models.\n\nBlocking a model and blocking one of its resolutions are different restrictions. A model block prevents the group from using that model. A resolution restriction blocks the selected resolution for that model.\n\n[User Groups](https://cdn.sanity.io/files/s479xw3z/production/83ef88c93d0772d79b9f12c267b7c9e390738729.mp4)\n\n## Assign people to the group\n\n- For a new invitation, select the group in the **User group** field under **Invites & seats**.\n\n- For an existing member, open their **three-dot menu → Add to user group**, select the group, and click **Done**.\n\n- For a pending invitation, open its **three-dot menu → Add to user group**.\n\n- To add people from the group, open **Edit group → Group members**, select the members, and click **Save**.\n\n[Adding members to group](https://cdn.sanity.io/files/s479xw3z/production/6292df1059a3bda19f59aa5673503525d9c71a3b.mp4)\n\nEach member can belong to one user group.
